deep-cosmos.$description: Deep Cosmos — Hero section background — the darkest brand surface, houses white headlines and violet accent text

violet-mid.$description: Violet Mid — CTA buttons in hero context, pill backgrounds — saturated mid-violet bridges cosmos and accent

lavender-pulse.$description: Lavender Pulse — Headline accent text ('anywhere.') in dark hero — vivid violet pops against #201547

pale-amethyst.$description: Pale Amethyst — Soft violet surface tint, used as background on secondary dark panels

indigo-shadow.$description: Indigo Shadow — Deep violet body text or decorative elements within dark sections

electric-lime.$description: Electric Lime — Product screenshot accent, border highlights — the neon counterpoint to deep purple creating visual tension

amber-core.$description: Amber Core — Icon fills and body-level accent color in light sections — warm, confident

butter-glow.$description: Butter Glow — Light amber for icon strokes, decorative fills — softer version of Amber Core

sky-mist.$description: Sky Mist — Button and panel backgrounds in light sections — very pale blue-gray tint

celadon-check.$description: Celadon Check — Success state chip background (e.g. green checkmark on Crypto selection chip)

powder-blue.$description: Powder Blue — UI illustration fill in product screenshots

midnight-ink.$description: Midnight Ink — Primary text, icon fills, borders — near-universal dark token

graphite.$description: Graphite — Body text, nav labels, CTA button background (dark pill), footer text

obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Dark section backgrounds, deepest surface in light-theme stacks

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Mid-dark surface, secondary panel backgrounds

slate.$description: Slate — Secondary body text, metadata, captions

ash.$description: Ash — Disabled states, light icon tones

bone.$description: Bone — Border separators, input outlines, card dividers

linen.$description: Linen — Warm-toned rule lines and subtle separators in cream body sections

warm-cream.$description: Warm Cream — Page body background — warm off-white gives light sections a tactile, paper-like quality vs pure white

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Card surfaces, nav background, input backgrounds, button text on dark

near-black.$description: Near Black — High-contrast body text alternative to pure black

bagosscondensedfont.$description: Primary display and hero headlines — the condensed cut lets oversized text fill wide containers without breaking; the -0.005em tracking tightens the text mass. This is Deel's most distinctive typographic voice: large, dense, confident headlines that compress horizontal space.

bagossextendedfont.$description: Section headers where width is the feature — extended cut fills horizontal space at large sizes, used for spread-out banner headlines like 'The Global People Platform'

bagossstandardfont.$description: UI labels, badge text, small captions — the workhorse standard cut at utility sizes

bagossstandardvf.$description: Navigation items and button labels — variable-font version allows optical tuning at this critical interactive size

inter.$description: All body copy, subheadings, stats, footer text, input values — Inter handles everything below headline level. The wide weight range (400–700) creates internal hierarchy without switching families. ss01/ss02 features keep it feeling designed rather than default.
